proof.pattern: track-B short exempt from the watch-day rule|track-B exempt short skipped

baseline_exempt_reason: both strings are new log lines added by #603 and this change; the baseline check confirms zero existing matches
expected_rate: only on a session with a Track B short against a LONG daily side and no confirmed watch day (replay ~0.45/day before the scope; live Track B signals were 7 in 12 sessions) — can be zero for several sessions
window_reason: the event needs a Track B breakdown short on a LONG-side symbol; ten sessions without one is still possible but worth a look
reversal: an exempt short traded with a widened stop; or exempt shorts' mean R from Alpaca fills after costs < -0.30R after 20 or < -0.15R at 40
